full_judgment: The suit instituted by the plaintiff is not maintain- able in the eye of law; that the suit is bad for non- joinder of parties; the suit is barred by limitation and by the principles of estoppel, waiver and acquiescence, also stated that the plaintiff has no cause of action for the suit as against the defendant Nos. 1 and 2.
